question: Should the schema-4-to-6 database migration and expanded portable-store contract in this PR ship in the next release based on focused tests, or require live copied-store upgrade proof first?
rationale: The code can validate migration mechanics, but choosing the acceptable proof level and long-term persistent-data compatibility contract requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept tested upgrade contract
options.body: Remove the changelog edits, review the focused migration coverage, and approve the exact green head for release.

options.title: Require copied-store proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real version-4 database and portable store are copied, upgraded, and inspected with before/after diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Accept tested upgrade contract
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog edits, review the focused migration coverage, and approve the exact green head for release.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent ownership signal across the exact sync, storage, enrichment, and migration changes under review.
